title: CatalogModifierChangedPayload
description: Payload of `catalog.modifier.changed` version 1: a question of a store's catalogue changed. The envelope's `partner_id` is the store's partner. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

change.description: What kind of change: the question `created`, `updated`, `deleted` or `duplicated` (the copy is the question named), or its `answers`.

revision.description: The catalogue's revision after the change, raised by every change; the version of the `catalog.changed` signal on the store's catalogue channel.
